case_overview: The appeal is directed against the judgment and order passed by the Andhra Pradesh High Court in Civil Miscellaneous Appeal No.2081 of 2004 . The High Court partly allowed the appeal filed by the Insurance Company (the respondent herein) and reduced the amount of compensation awarded by the Tribunal .
